s: Install Library first, then follow the first steps in Install.
Bookmarks, apps, folders, and terminal commands open from the menu bar, a keyboard shortcut, or Spotlight.
Press Control-Space to search your whole library.
Library remembers what you copy.
Save text you type often, such as an address or a standard reply, as a snippet.
Choose Edit Library… to manage everything in one window.
Select an item and press ⌘I.
Write a note on any item in Get Info.
Put {} in a URL where a value goes.
Add a bookmark to the Reading List from its right-click menu, or press Tab in Quick Open.
A shortcut can be a key combination, a modified click, a scroll, a pinch, a swipe, or a hot corner.
Spotlight finds your bookmarks, apps, and commands.
While Library runs, it checks GitHub for a new release every hour.
Press ⌘, to open Settings.
Keyboard shortcuts, hot corners, Quick Open, and the menus don't need any permission.
A shortcut doesn't work.
Library keeps your library and clipboard history on your Mac.
Your files are in ~/.library/: Files in ~/.library File Contents bookmarks.json Your items, folders, shortcuts, and order clipboard.json Pinned clipboard items,
Library connects to the internet only for these things.
To lock pinned items, turn on Require Touch ID or password to show pinned items in Settings > Clipboard.
To keep your library in iCloud Drive, turn on Keep Library in iCloud Drive in Settings > General.
Operating system macOS 26 or later Developer tools Xcode Command Line Tools
Paste this into Terminal.
Press Control-Space to open Quick Open.
Library checks for updates itself.
Quit Library.
Run./build.sh to build the app.
Run./test.sh to run the checks in Tests/.
To publish a release, push a tag such as vX.Y.Z: git tag vX.Y.Z git push origin vX.Y.Z Or run the Release workflow by hand and enter a version.
Library is in English.
If text has an address, a phone number, or a date, Library offers actions for it.
In Copy as, Smart Punctuation turns straight quotes and dashes into curly quotes, apostrophes, em dashes, and ellipses.
Turn on Name new bookmarks from their pages in Settings > General.
In the Edit Library window, open the sort menu in the header.
